name: why
title: why
summary: Explain a problem: a ranked list of likely causes with evidence and runnable fixes, from the documents and the diagnostics bus.
html:
Explain a problem: a ranked list of likely causes with evidence and runnable fixes, from the documents and the diagnostics bus.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: why
  • MCP: ara_why

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
questionWhat to explain: an entity and symptom (name:Crate not visible), a code (ARA1302), an asset (@meshes/crate.glb) or a topic (did reload fall back to L3, is the frame slow).
docDocument for entity selectors (default: the one holding the entity, else the main scene).
listList the explainers and example questions instead of answering.
fullReturn the whole report as JSON (causes with evidence, checks, related). Default: the text plus the runnable fixes, which is what agents need and costs about half the tokens.
